plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("charm pricing" OR "left-digit effect" OR ".99 pricing" OR "odd pricing") AND (pricing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR marketing)
queries.rationale: Focuses on the specific effect of odd-ending prices on consumer perception and purchase decisions.

queries.query: ("discount depth" OR "discount size" OR "price promotion") AND (perceived quality OR brand image OR brand equity OR "brand perception")
queries.rationale: Targets research on how the magnitude of discounts interacts with and potentially harms brand evaluations.

queries.query: ("ad creative" OR "advertisement design" OR "advertising appeal") AND (conversion OR "click-through rate" OR CTR OR "purchase intent")
queries.rationale: Seeks empirical studies linking specific elements of ad creative (imagery, text, format) to concrete performance metrics.

queries.query: ("product naming" OR "brand name" OR "product name") AND (memorability OR recall OR "consumer preference" OR perception)
queries.rationale: Catches research on how different linguistic and phonetic characteristics of a name influence consumer memory and evaluation.

queries.query: ("scarcity cues" OR "limited quantity" OR "limited time") AND (purchase OR conversion OR "purchase urgency" OR "checkout behavior")
queries.rationale: Focuses on the effectiveness of scarcity and time-pressure messages in driving immediate consumer action.

queries.query: ("default option" OR "opt-out" OR "pre-selected") AND (choice OR adoption OR enrollment OR "conversion rate")
queries.rationale: Targets the powerful, evidence-based nudge of setting defaults to increase desired behavior in sign-ups or checkouts.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR "customer reviews" OR "user testimonials") AND (trust OR credibility OR "purchase likelihood" OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Seeks studies on how different types and presentations of social evidence (review volume, valence, photos) build trust and drive sales.

queries.query: ("loss aversion" OR "framing" OR "gain framing" OR "loss framing") AND (promotion OR messaging OR advertisement OR "consumer decision")
queries.rationale: Captures research on how framing offers in terms of avoiding a loss versus gaining a benefit differentially impacts consumer response.

queries.query: ("free shipping" OR "shipping cost" OR "minimum order") AND (cart abandonment OR "basket size" OR "purchase completion")
queries.rationale: Focuses on the tangible impact of shipping costs and policies on the final stages of the e-commerce conversion funnel.

queries.query: ("A/B testing" OR "split testing" OR "randomized experiment") AND (ecommerce OR "landing page" OR "email marketing" OR "digital advertising")
queries.rationale: Targets applied papers on running field experiments in digital marketing contexts, highlighting practical findings and methodological insights.

queries.query: ("personalization" OR "targeted advertising" OR "recommendation system") AND (privacy concern OR "creepiness" OR "reactance")
queries.rationale: Catches evidence on when and why personalized marketing efforts can backfire by triggering consumer privacy concerns or reactance.

queries.query: ("visual complexity" OR "information load" OR "website design") AND (landing page OR "product page" OR "decision difficulty")
queries.rationale: Seeks research on how the visual and informational complexity of a webpage affects consumer processing and conversion.

queries.query: ("price anchoring" OR "reference price" OR "decoy effect") AND (choice OR "willingness to pay" OR "product selection")
queries.rationale: Focuses on how presenting prices in relation to other prices (anchors, decoys) shapes perceived value and choice.

queries.query: ("mobile checkout" OR "one-click" OR "payment friction") AND (conversion OR abandonment OR "purchase process")
queries.rationale: Targets studies specifically on reducing friction in the mobile or final payment stage of the e-commerce journey.

queries.query: ("return policy" OR "free returns" OR "lenient returns") AND (purchase risk OR "purchase intention" OR "consumer trust")
queries.angle: Return policy as a marketing tool
queries.rationale: Captures evidence on how return policy leniency functions not just as a cost but as a risk-reducer that can increase initial purchases.

plan.coverage_notes: Plan focuses on high-impact, testable psychological levers (pricing, scarcity, social proof, framing) and e-commerce friction points (shipping, checkout, returns) directly relevant to a growth marketer. Skips broad brand strategy, advertising theory, media planning, and historical analysis. Assumes the reader values concrete causal findings from field experiments over correlational survey studies or purely theoretical models.
